newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean January shipbuilding orders fall.
newsitem.headline: South Korean January shipbuilding orders fall.

text.p: South Korean shipyards won orders totalling 230,500 gross tons for five ships in January, down from 232,700 gross tons for five ships in the same period a year ago, shipbuilders said on Wednesday.

The Korea Shipbuilders' Association said all ships were for export. The KSA said ship construction for the month totalled 293,000 gross tons for eight ships, up from 245,850 gross tons for eight ships a year ago.
The backlog of orders at the end of January was 13.04 million gross tons (276 ships), compared with 13.82 million gross tons (304 ships) a year ago, the association said.
